The paper reports three OmniNA parameter scales, while the atlas names generic OmniNA and OmniNA-1.7B; the generic trajectories cover the shared family architecture and the explicit OmniNA-1.7B trajectories cover the named 1.7B variant.

The feature-representation section does not specify the exact tokenizer-to-sequence aggregation implementation, transformer-layer extraction interface, or the complete handling of special tokens and masks.
